issuer: the Department of Transport Management and its transport management offices
note: Read 2026-10-30 on the Nepal Law Commission's own site (lawcommission.gov.np, volume 9 of the Acts and volume 9(B) of the Rules). The Motor Vehicles and Transport Management Act, 2049 (authenticated 2049-09-22 BS, with its amendments to the Act amending some Nepal Acts, 2082 (2082-04-14 BS)): s. 47(kha) disqualifies a person under 18 from a driving licence for medium and small vehicles (a car is a small vehicle; 16 for a motorcycle, 21 for heavy vehicles); s. 51 has the licence given on the test first issued on probation for one year, and turned permanent on request if its conditions weren't broken more than five times, so the full (permanent) licence is held from 19, the age of 18 and the probationary year added (a reading from the Act's two stages); s. 54(3), as amended in 2082, keeps a licence in force ten years from the day it is given, and s. 56(3) renews it for ten more. The Motor Vehicles and Transport Management Rules, 2054 (with ten amendments to 2081-10-10 BS): rule 20(1) has the licence applied for with the fee of Schedule 3, which sets the driving licence application fee at Rs 500 (separately for each kind of vehicle applied for), held as the licence's fee; rule 20A has the licence issued as an electronic smart card, and any separate charge for the card wasn't found in the Rules and isn't held. The issuer is read from the Department of Transport Management's own site (dotm.gov.np), whose notices list licences printed for its transport management offices (not cited). The Commission's PDFs carry a text layer in which some Devanagari letters are mapped wrongly (as वर्व for वर्ष, मनममत्त for निमित्त, अिुमनतपत्र for अनुमतिपत्र): the quotations below are that layer's words, checked by eye against the page. s. 52 lets the holder of a foreign licence be given a licence without a test, naming no countries, so no exchange list is held. No identity card is issued by the Department.

sources.title: सवारी तथा यातायात व्यवस्था ऐन, २०४९ (Motor Vehicles and Transport Management Act, 2049), Nepal Law Commission
